It is located to the southwest of Peckern , the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent , the southwest of West Metropolis Archipelago and the northeast of Centopia . On May 4 2022 this island was split into Peckern and Twenty-Second Districts, but the entire island became a part of Peckern on May 6 2023 . Location Airship Island is located to the southwest of Peckern Continent and the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent . This island is named after three administrators of Project Nazca who have made a lot of contributions to the server, and are coincidentally all named Edward. However, on February 29 2020 , due to historical reasons, the former owner of this island permanently left the server, and a year afterwards, new plans to turn this island into an island with Olympic-grade facilities are put in place. excerpt: The '''In-Station Transit''' is a type of transportation in Nazca Railway that connects passengers within the station, or from the concourse to its outlying exits. This method is mostly used in Island (Type IV) Stations, but examples of In-Station Transits also exist in other Station Types. Style Stations of In-Station Transits mostly follow the Platform Design from Terracept Division , and all its stations have their own names and color themes. title: Los Sengas Trunk Roads
excerpt: '''Los Sengas Trunk Roads''' act as main arteries for Los Sengas land transport, and provides direct and convenient access between different districts of Los Sengas. Earlier Trunk Roads (Routes 1-7) are paved with gray concrete, whereas newer Trunk Roads, including newer sections of Route 7 and Routes numbered 8 or above, uses gray concrete instead. Most Trunk roads have more than two lanes for each side and are dual carriageways. All exits are either set on the left side of the road or are graded junctions. title: Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors
excerpt: Nazca Railway is the first Minecraft Railway System in the world to widely adopt Platform Screen Doors for all its stations during construction and operation. Technical Information Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors (PSDs) are based on the Vanilla Redstone System that came with Minecraft. The "Hardware" of the PSD mainly consists of glass, and redstone lamps are used as indicators for door status (Open/Close). Pistons, command blocks and redstone wiring are also designed in the fashion of a switch. title: Wah Tin
excerpt: '''Wah Tin''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum . It is the Northernmost Sub-District of Asylum , and its District Code is 29-01. History The name of this Sub-District originates from the deceased Grandfather of the Developer of Asylum who passed away a few years ago. Since then, the Developer has always wanted to use this name at cities that he constructed, and eventually this name is used to the northeast of Arctic Sea to symbolize prosperity. Prior to the relocation of the Asylum City Center from Arctic Sea to Brighton Hall , Wah Tin was planned to contain Public Housing Settlements within a close vicinity to the Town Center.
